| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

**Champion v5 holds** — Last candidate showed better out-of-sample min but worse in-sample stability and drawdown.

## System Health
```
✓ Runloop active: 179 iterations / 19h elapsed
✓ No INCONCLUSIVE blocking queue
✓ ~29h remaining in budget
```

## Next Context Actions

Execute the provided commands to continue autonomous search:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Key Observations for Next Instance

1. **Tuning min fragility**: Candidate dropped to 0.05 on some folds — investigate fold-specific regime sensitivity
2. **Lockbox generalization gap**: Candidate actually beat champion on lockbox_min — worth exploring why in-sample/out-of-sample diverge
3. **MDD threshold**: -11.18% worst MDD exceeded -10% soft target — prioritize drawdown control experiments

No intervention needed. System operating within parameters.
